reviews.reason: This role expresses an asynchronous live region or custom adjustable separator/widget. The source below supplies the actual owner and keyboard contract; native output/hr/input would change that contract. This fixture intentionally includes a focusable custom role=slider widget alongside input/contenteditable/button to verify PageCanvas does not steal Enter/Space from inner interactive targets. It needs a complete slider ARIA value contract, while replacing it with input range would remove this custom-widget ownership case.
